title: SEAR EduAdapt ablation: code and held-out results for educationally adapted sentence embeddings (SciEntsBank)
description: Code, fold-wise thresholds, per-instance predictions (without answer text) and figures for a held-out ablation comparing TF-IDF, a general Sentence-BERT encoder (all-mpnet-base-v2) and SBERT-EduAdapt on the official SciEntsBank test splits (UA, UQ, UD).
